name: ppp-calculator-v2
description: PPP Calculator v2. Same money. Different prices. (Cloudflare Workers assets)

scripts.sync-assets: mkdir -p public/data public/fonts public/styles && cp index.html public/index.html && cp app.js public/app.js && cp styles.css public/styles.css && cp styles/fonts.css styles/tokens.css styles/base.css styles/components.css public/styles/ && cp robots.txt public/robots.txt && cp favicon.svg public/favicon.svg && cp og-image.svg public/og-image.svg && cp data/countries.json public/data/countries.json && cp data/commodities.json public/data/commodities.json && cp fonts/*.woff2 fonts/*.txt fonts/README.md public/fonts/ 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.deploy: npm run sync-assets && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run sync-assets && npx wrangler dev
